description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally VIII Creature Subtype(s) Elemental (Elder) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Garulessa — Gorgias (1/day Snowstorm) — Grendel (1/day Breath and Fireball) — Ignis Fatuus (7 MP, no invisibility) (Earth, Fire, Water, Wind) Neo Garula — Sharnbulette — Tot Aevis (1/day Breath Wing) (Avian) White Cait (7 MP) — This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 8th-level list with a CR rating of 12 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 7th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 6th-level or lower lists.
